verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both halves are stated, in a rescaled encoding. (i) The sign-independence η_{(ℓ,a,+)} = η_{(ℓ,a,−)} is `physicalMask_signedLabel`, and it holds by `rfl`: `physicalMask` reads only `L.1` (the band ℓ) and `L.2.1` (the grid cell a) and never the sign slot `L.2.2`, so the Lean mask is literally a function of the unsigned label. (ii) The squared partition of unity is `physical_mask_tail_sum_sq`: the finsum of `mask D (tailLabel N U) q x ^ 2` over all `U : ℕ × Grid` equals 1. The rewriting: Lean's single finsum over the product type ℕ × Grid is the paper's iterated ∑_ℓ ∑_a (the iterated form is `SquaredPartition.labelMask_tail_sum_sq`); the paper's `∘ 𝒞_ℓ` (precomposition with the band-ℓ chart) is carried inside `physicalSlowMask`, which is `slowMask` precomposed with `slowCoordinates D n`, i.e. coordinatewise division by Q_n^{axisExponent}; the paper's restriction a ∈ I_ℓ has no Lean counterpart because Lean sums over the whole grid, which is at least as strong provided the terms outside I_ℓ vanish; the paper's implicit restriction to the active shell is carried by the hypotheses `0 < q` and `q ≤ ChartScales.Q N` together with `tailLabel N` (bands shifted to start at N).
